basic_info.description: Light-filled and full of charm, this beautifully updated TIC in vibrant Upper Haight blends classic San Francisco character with modern convenience. Move-in-ready having been renovated in 2020 and freshly updated for market with new kitchen flooring, lighting, and paint, this home boasts elegant period details and abundant natural light from oversized east- and west-facing windows. A flexible floor plan includes a grand rear bedroom and two additional rooms perfect for living, dining, WFH, or guest space easily adaptable to your lifestyle. The bright kitchen offers generous storage and opens to stairs leading to a lush, landscaped shared yard that has grapefruit, 2-kinds of lemon, lime, orange and tangerine trees! Enjoy dedicated laundry and ample storage in the garage. Ideally located just blocks from the best of Upper Haight and Cole Valley iconic eateries, boutique shops, great coffee, and multiple transit options. With Golden Gate Park and the Panhandle nearby, groceries, and urban amenities at your fingertips, this turnkey home delivers the perfect balance of serenity and city living.  Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a timeless piece of San Francisco.
